about: Part chasemove's entries (docs/GAME.md 2.4 row chasemove, 'Inputs and outputs'; docs/game-parts/chasemove.md). Upstream keeps the actor in AP (_Dp+8, p_enemy65.s's callee-saved pointer) for pMove, tryWalk, newChaseDir and doNewChaseDir, which A_Chase calls with a jsr; the public P_TryWalk and P_NewChaseDir take it in _Dp[0-3]. Natively each entry takes the actor in GA_0-1. pMove returns A (1 moved, or a special line opened; 0 not) and leaves numspechit at -1 ($FF natively) when it walked the special lines (or P_TryMove walked the crossed ones), and as it was with no move (DI_NODIR): numspechit is an input too. newChaseDir and P_NewChaseDir return nothing: movedir, movecount, the lines' stamps and validcount are canonical state. tryWalk and P_TryWalk return A (1 moved). The checkpoint (tools/native/gparts/chasemove.py) runs pMove and newChaseDir, their calls captured inside A_Chase (P_NewChaseDir and P_TryWalk are never called in the release); places as tools/native/gparts/checkpos.py's place() reads them (gw: glayout's tic GW fields).
